title: Cargo, parking and everyday security
summary: Learn how the rack, kickstand, frame lock and bell support ordinary city use without confusing convenience hardware with unlimited capacity or complete theft protection.

steps.title: The rack transfers luggage load into the frame.
steps.body: A rear rack supports compatible bags or cargo and sends those forces through its mounts into the bicycle structure.
steps.keyFact: The allowable load is defined by the actual rack, frame, bicycle and accessory system—not by a universal Bike Atlas number.

steps.title: The kickstand supports a stationary bike, not every loading situation.
steps.body: A kickstand makes ordinary parking and light loading more convenient. Stability depends on surface, bicycle orientation, cargo distribution and the stand's own design.
steps.keyFact: A deployed kickstand is not a guarantee that a loaded bicycle cannot tip.

steps.title: A frame lock immobilizes a wheel.
steps.body: The frame-mounted lock can block wheel rotation and is convenient for short stops or as one layer of security. It does not anchor the whole bicycle to an immovable object.
steps.keyFact: Immobilizing a wheel and securing a bicycle against removal are different security functions.

steps.title: The bell is a communication device.
steps.body: A bell gives the rider a simple audible way to signal presence. Its use should complement observation, appropriate speed and yielding behavior rather than replace them.
steps.keyFact: Audible warning is one part of awareness, not a substitute for safe riding decisions.

steps.title: Find the structure designed to carry everyday luggage.
steps.body: Identify the load-carrying structure over the rear wheel.
steps.keyFact: The rack is the dedicated cargo support; the fender is not a load platform.

challenge.prompt: Which component is designed to support compatible luggage?
challenge.successText: Correct. The rear rack is the dedicated cargo-support structure.
challenge.retryText: That part supports utility use, but it is not the cargo platform.
